description: Test script for simulating network behaviors using prplMesh's simulation framework, including fixtures, expectation checks, message handling, and network event testing.

classes.name: Expect
classes.description: Helper class for registering and checking expected network events during simulation.

classes.name: AlgorithmTest
classes.description: Test implementation of sim.Algorithm to verify start and timeout events.

classes.name: AlgorithmTestMessage
classes.description: Test implementation of sim.Algorithm to verify message handling.

methods.name: add_expectation
methods.description: Adds an expected event with timing, type, and argument.

methods.name: check_event
methods.description: Checks if an event matches the expected event.

methods.name: event_callback
methods.description: Callback for event occurrence, verifies against expectations.

methods.name: timeout_callback
methods.description: Callback for timeout events, verifies against expectations.

methods.name: check_run
methods.description: Verifies the last event occurred at the expected time.

methods.name: check_done
methods.description: Asserts that all expectations have been met.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the test algorithm, sets a timeout.

methods.name: handle_message
methods.description: Handles incoming messages and verifies message type.
